Bash(# Create comprehensive token analysis
echo ""🔍 COMPREHENSIVE SOURCE CODE TOKEN AUDIT""
echo ""==========================================""
echo ""Analysis Date: $(date)""
echo ""Base Path: /mnt/d/Github/studio""
echo """"

# TypeScript/JavaScript Analysis
echo ""📁 TYPESCRIPT/JAVASCRIPT FILES""
echo ""--------------------------------""
ts_chars=454293
ts_files=98
ts_tokens=$((ts_chars / 4))  # Conservative estimate: 4 chars per token for code
echo ""Total Characters: $(printf ""%''d"" $ts_chars)""
echo ""Total Files: $ts_files""
echo ""Estimated Tokens: $(printf ""%''d"" $ts_tokens)""
echo ""Average Tokens per File: $((ts_tokens / ts_files))""
echo """"

# JSON Configuration Analysis  
echo ""📁 JSON CONFIGURATION FILES""
echo ""-----------------------------""
json_chars=24410
json_files=13
json_tokens=$((json_chars / 4))  # JSON is also code-like
echo ""Total Characters: $(printf ""%''d"" $json_chars)""
echo ""Total Files: $json_files""
echo ""Estimated Tokens: $(printf ""%''d"" $json_tokens)""
echo ""Average Tokens per File: $((json_tokens / json_files))""
echo """"

# CSS Analysis
echo ""📁 CSS/STYLING FILES""
echo ""---------------------""
css_chars=4063
css_files=1
css_tokens=$((css_chars / 5))  # CSS has fewer tokens per character
echo ""Total Characters: $(printf ""%''d"" $css_chars)""
echo ""Total Files: $css_files"" 
echo ""Estimated Tokens: $(printf ""%''d"" $css_tokens)""
echo """"

# Calculate Totals
total_chars=$((ts_chars + json_chars + css_chars))
total_files=$((ts_files + json_files + css_files))
total_tokens=$((ts_tokens + json_tokens + css_tokens))

echo ""📊 SUMMARY TOTALS""
echo ""==================""
echo ""Total Source Files: $total_files""
echo ""Total Characters: $(printf ""%''d"" $total_chars)""
echo ""Total Estimated Tokens: $(printf ""%''d"" $total_tokens)""
echo """"

# Claude Limit Analysis
claude_limit=200000
usage_percent=$((total_tokens * 100 / claude_limit))
remaining=$((claude_limit - total_tokens))

echo ""🤖 CLAUDE CODE CONTEXT ANALYSIS""
echo ""================================""
echo ""Claude Code Token Limit: $(printf ""%''d"" $claude_limit)""
echo ""Current Token Usage: $(printf ""%''d"" $total_tokens)""
echo ""Usage Percentage: ${usage_percent}%""

if [ $total_tokens -gt $claude_limit ]; then
    overage=$((total_tokens - claude_limit))
    echo ""Status: ⚠️  EXCEEDS LIMIT by $(printf ""%''d"" $overage) tokens""
else
    echo ""Remaining Capacity: $(printf ""%''d"" $remaining) tokens""
    echo ""Status: ✅ Within Limit""
fi)
